scope: all retained evidence that could be interpreted as a comparison of 40/40/20 and 70/20/10 TDD allocations
reason: The TDD allocation and vehicle placement/signal context changed together. No newly collected same-placement 40/40/20 control exists for the 70/20/10 follow-up.
valid_uses: report RTT, response availability, and deadline availability for each recorded operating condition
report the 70/20/10 vehicle-to-edge and edge-to-vehicle direction controls as single-profile measurements
use the retained values as provenance and as inputs to the design of the new matched comparison
prohibited_inferences: attribute an observed latency, availability, or throughput difference to TDD allocation
describe the retained data as evidence of TDD sensitivity
generalize the 70/20/10 directional throughput result to another TDD profile

evidence_families.name: 70/20/10 host-side direction control
evidence_families.missing_control: same-placement 40/40/20 vehicle-to-edge and edge-to-vehicle direction measurements

replacement_evidence.requirement: new same-placement, same-signal-context, Cell-2-locked matched blocks under 40/40/20 and 70/20/10 with all other application and network controls held constant
